name: Transport Means 5
definition: Describes the multimodal or the individual transport of goods.

IndividualTransport.name: Individual Transport
IndividualTransport.definition: Moving of goods or people from one place to another by vehicle.

MultimodalTransport.name: Multimodal Transport
MultimodalTransport.definition: Specifies the different movements and places and their role in a multimodal conveyance of goods.
